title: Moss BRCA2 lacking canonical DNA binding domain promotes efficient homologous recombination and binds to DNA
authors: Alice Chanteau; Suliane Quilleré; Arthur Crouset; Sreejith Allipra; Ulysse Tuquoi; Pierre-François Perroud; Simona Miron; Pauline Dupaigne; Sophie Zinn-Justin; Fabien Nogué; Rajeev Kumar
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苔藓BRCA2蛋白通过无序N端结合单链DNA并促进同源重组，虽涉及蛋白-DNA结合但无AI或物理模拟方法，且非典型TF-DNA体系，仅具间接参考价值。
abstract: BRCA2 interacts with RAD51 and DMC1 recombinases and binds to single-stranded DNA (ssDNA), through its canonical DNA binding domain (DBD) to mediate homology-directed DNA repair (HDR). While the well-folded DBD is widely conserved in diverse eukaryotes, a non-canonical BRCA2 variant lacking this domain is found in Drosophila melanogaster . Whether such a non-canonical BRCA2 variant exists in other species is unknown. Additionally, the DNA-binding activity of a BRCA2 variant lacking DBD remains unclear. Here, we identify a new non-canonical BRCA2 in the model plant Physcomitrium patens (PpBRCA2). We establish that PpBRCA2 is essential for genome integrity maintenance, somatic DNA repair, HDR-mediated gene targeting, and RAD51 foci recruitment at DNA break sites. PpBRCA2 is also critical for DNA repair during meiosis, but interacts only weakly with DMC1, suggesting a distinct meiotic function compared to other BRCA2 homologs. Despite lacking the canonical DBD, PpBRCA2 binds ssDNA through its disordered N-terminal region and efficiently promotes HDR. Our work highlights that the ssDNA binding capacity of BRCA2 homologs is conserved regardless of the presence of canonical DBD and provides a deeper understanding of BRCA2’s functional diversity across species. Three Key messages Physcomitrium patens BRCA2 (PpBRCA2) lacking canonical DBD mediates homologous recombination and promotes genome stability PpBRCA2 differentially interact with RAD51 and DMC1 PpBRCA2 binds single-stranded DNA via its N-terminal to compensate for the loss of canonical DBD
abstract_zh: BRCA2通过其经典DNA结合结构域（DBD）与RAD51和DMC1重组酶相互作用，并结合单链DNA（ssDNA），以介导同源定向DNA修复（HDR）。尽管结构良好的DBD在多种真核生物中广泛保守，但在黑腹果蝇（Drosophila melanogaster）中发现了一种缺乏该结构域的非经典BRCA2变体。这种非经典BRCA2变体是否存在于其他物种中尚不清楚。此外，缺乏DBD的BRCA2变体的DNA结合活性仍不明确。在此，我们在模式植物小立碗藓（Physcomitrium patens）中鉴定出一种新的非经典BRCA2（PpBRCA2）。我们证实PpBRCA2对于基因组完整性维持、体细胞DNA修复、HDR介导的基因靶向以及DNA断裂位点的RAD51焦点招募至关重要。PpBRCA2在减数分裂期间的DNA修复中也起关键作用，但与DMC1仅发生微弱相互作用，表明其与其他BRCA2同源物相比具有不同的减数分裂功能。尽管缺乏经典DBD，PpBRCA2通过其无序的N端区域结合ssDNA，并有效促进HDR。我们的工作强调，BRCA2同源物的ssDNA结合能力在有无经典DBD的情况下均保守，并提供了对BRCA2跨物种功能多样性的更深入理解。三条关键信息：缺乏经典DBD的小立碗藓BRCA2（PpBRCA2）介导同源重组并促进基因组稳定性；PpBRCA2与RAD51和DMC1差异性地相互作用；PpBRCA2通过其N端结合单链DNA以补偿经典DBD的缺失。
